_about: The read behind statistics/pod.html (Friends and enemies of the pod), Fish only.
One entry per mention that stats_pod.py finds. e = episode, t = seconds, p = the phrase as matched (lower case),
q = the start of the line (just to help a reader). v = friend | enemy | acquaintance | not | unclear.
who = the names declared (a list: one line can declare several), written the same way every time.
why = a few words from what was said. 'not' = not a declaration (the Club Fish tier, sarcasm, a question...).
A mention with no entry, or v = unclear, shows under 'Not yet read' on the page. Reads match by episode,
phrase and nearest time within 20 s, so re-timed transcripts keep them. names = a better summary 'why' for a name.
